responsibility: Provides semantic support for D’s `alias this` feature at expression level. It resolves implicit forwarding from an aggregate expression or type to the designated aliased member, including property resolution, `typeof` handling when an implicit `this` call is needed, and overload-sensitive conversion for aliased methods, and it also implements the small symbol-side operations for the `AliasThis` AST node itself.
same_name_distinction: Defines the executable semantic logic for `alias this`—especially expression/type resolution through the aliased member via `resolveAliasThis` and basic `AliasThis` methods—whereas `aliasthis.h` only declares the `AliasThis` AST node and its stored fields.
